business_problem: The company wanted to unify its data and provide a comprehensive analytics solution to improve operations.
solution_summary: PZ Cussons International, a Consumer Goods organization in United Kingdom, modernized this data lake / data warehouse modernization workload with Microsoft Fabric, Azure Databricks, Azure Data Factory, and Microsoft Copilot. The company wanted to unify its data and provide a comprehensive analytics solution to improve operations. Microsoft Fabric unifies data engineering, storage, analytics, and BI on a shared data platform. Azure Databricks processes, engineers, and analyzes data workloads on scalable Spark infrastructure. Azure Data Factory orchestrates data movement and transformation pipelines between operational and analytical systems. PZ Cussons International connects approved internal data sources into Microsoft 365 services, grounds responses through Azure Databricks, and serves generated answers and drafts back to users through Microsoft Fabric. Uses a shared Microsoft Fabric data foundation for analytics and reporting workloads.

PZ Cussons transforms data analytics with Microsoft Fabric, improving decision-making and efficiency

PZ Cussons deployed Microsoft Fabric and Azure Databricks to ingest and harmonize data from various sources, providing accurate sales, market share, and price data for an initial use case, Revenue Growth Management.

To grow smartly and sustainably, businesses must have a profound understanding of customers—and this begins with data. International hygiene, baby, and beauty consumer goods company PZ Cussons is dedicated to the wellbeing of people, and to better serve them, the company needed to know customers more completely. Facing data and analytics challenges, PZ Cussons explored technologies to eliminate data silos, improve data quality, and move teams from reliance on manual processes and offline reports to a centralized data platform.
